title: Real timeBooking website
description:
Neelawala Express Bus Booking System
A complete online reservation platform built for NEELAWALA CUSHION HOUSE, a real transport company operating nightly Semi Luxury buses between Kaduruwela and Mathara, Sri Lanka.

The system lets passengers select travel dates, choose exact seats from a live 57 seat interactive map, verify their phone via OTP, and pay online all in a single-page booking flow. Seats update in real time with temporary locking to prevent double bookings, and gender-based seat selection provides a safe ladies seating option.

The admin dashboard gives the bus owner full control: fleet management , booking oversight, manual bookings for reserved seats, passenger records, revenue reports, and stop/price management.

Stack: Laravel 12 · PHP 8.2 · MySQL · Tailwind CSS · JavaScript (AJAX) · Blade · Flatpickr
Deployed: Live demo on InfinityFree · Client launch on Provider.lk with Commercial Bank payment gateway integration
